event_name: NAPA Auto Parts NHRA Midwest Nationals

pairs.note:
Weather conditions: air temperature 79 degrees, relative humidity 45 percent, barometer 30.14 inches, adjusted
altitude 1,984 feet, track temperature 116 degrees.

Stanfield is 12 - 6 against Coughlin Jr. in prior events. 

They both take their time staging, Coughlin Jr. goes in first and Stanfield follows right in. Coughlin Jr.
with the starting line advantage and has tire shake and pedals it.  Stanfield with tire shake right at the hit
and pedaled it and got it hook up enough to get the win.  He is advancing to his third final round this season
and 30th career.

Glenn is 4 - 3 against Stanfield in prior events. 

Glenn with the starting line advantage, but Stanfield has the lead has they go by the Christmas tree.  He
takes the win and will have lane choice over Aaron in the final.  Greg is advancing to his fourth final this
season and 32 career.
